/// The metadata value (auto-detected scalar unless --as-json is set).
/// Show the current project's ID and root, as a view or as JSON with `--json`.
/// The metadata value (auto-detected scalar unless --as-json is set).
//! Shared `--metadata` / `--metadata-json` flag parsing for create/update commands.
/// `--metadata-json '<json-object>'` strings, layered on top of an optional base.
/// `--metadata-json` objects are then merged shallow on top so they can override.
/// * `json_blobs` - the `--metadata-json` values, each a JSON object
return Err(Error::Argument("--metadata-json must be a JSON object".to_string()));
